newsitem.title: USA: Kinetic Concepts holders to seek control.
newsitem.headline: Kinetic Concepts holders to seek control.

text.p: A group including San Francisco investor Richard Blum said Friday it was seeking to take control of Kinetic Concepts.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group, which holds collectively 3,679,950 Kinetic shares, or an 8.67 percent stake, said it had decided to formally make its interests known to the company.
On July 10, certain members of the group agreed to submit a "joint indication of interest" to the company, through the company's adviser Alex Brown & Sons Inc.
Depending on the company's response, the investors said in the filing, they have agreed to proceed as a group to seek control of the company in a "friendly, privately-negotiated transaction."

San Antonio, Texas-based Kinetic in May said it had retained Alex Brown to help evaluate strategic options and alternatives for increasing shareholder value. The company makes specialty beds, mattress replacement systems and related medical devices for patients that are immobile.
